source_equation_check.source: All six Table 1 Us-up states, independently deposited in PANGAEA
source_equation_check.qualification: Descriptive width comparison at printed up; source confidence and Us-up covariance are unknown. Not a formal sigma or chi-square test.

independent_diagnostic_refit.objective: Equal vertical Us residuals on all six shots; source objective/weights unknown
independent_diagnostic_refit.covariance_convention: RSS/(6-2) times inverse normal matrix; conditional on printed up treated as exact. No source confidence inference or initial-state uncertainty propagation.

rankine_hugoniot_replay.notes: Each shot uses its own printed initial density; calculated source P/rho are not independent measurements. Printed precision limits exact replay.

operational_path.interpretation: Full empirical experimental shock path; Possible melting at higher pressures; density data do not resolve the phase state.
operational_path.initial_temperature_basis: Conventional ambient normalization; not a reported numeric precursor measurement or a constant shock temperature

qualification: Published six-shot linear Us-up relation retained, with conditional coefficient agreement within both reported error widths under an equal-Us-weight diagnostic. Source confidence, covariance and exact fitting weights are unspecified; this is not recovered author-workflow or uncertainty parity. The published empirical principal Hugoniot is retained over its full experimental range, 85.6-245 GPa. Possible melting at higher pressures; density data do not resolve the phase state. All six shots remain data and source-fit inputs. Mean porous precursor density 7.525(0.010) g/cm3 is explicitly adopted as the common path normalization; individual measured initial densities remain unchanged. V0 is a mass-equivalent bulk volume including approximately 2% porosity, not a diffraction lattice volume or the Sata nonmagnetic V0. The 300 K reference is conventional precursor normalization, not measured shock temperature. The separate thermal reduction and the 7.982 g/cm3 Gruneisen reference are not installed as this Hugoniot.
